tool.name: read-ref
tool.description:
Read back original content that was replaced by a `[SHORT_REF ...]` pointer during context compaction. The LLM encounters a SHORT_REF marker in the (compacted) message history of the form:
[SHORT_REF type=file path=/path/to/file range=1-100 hash=sha256:<hex>]
and calls this tool to retrieve the original content. Read-back is content-addressed: the tool verifies that the archived content's SHA-256 matches the `hash` argument before returning it.
Arguments: - hash (required): the `sha256:<hex>` read-back key from the SHORT_REF marker - type (optional): content source category hint (file | search | grep | glob) - path (optional): locating hint (file path / search dir) - range (optional): range hint (e.g. line range `1-100`)
Result: - On hash match: the original archived content is returned verbatim. - On hash mismatch, missing reference, or no archive available: an explicit error is returned ("content changed / reference invalid, please re-read"). read-ref never returns empty or stale content when the reference is invalid.

read-ref.explanation: 读回一个已失效的引用

tool-result.error: read-ref: reference invalid — no archived content for hash sha256:0000000000000000. The content may have been evicted, the session restarted, or the hash is incorrect. Please re-read the original source.
